name: render_drawio
description: Draw an editable draw.io architecture diagram from a graph that collect_inventory saved. Layout (Region, VPC, Availability Zone, subnets, then a left-to-right flow for everything else) is automatic, and an empty default VPC is hidden automatically. Use hide_ids to leave out resources that are not part of the workload. Use connections to add links from the customer's flow description: both ends must be node ids returned by collect_inventory; anything else is rejected and reported.

hide_ids.description: Node ids from collect_inventory to leave out.

connections.description: Links from the flow description, drawn as dashed labelled lines.

from.description: Node id from collect_inventory where the step starts.

to.description: Node id from collect_inventory where the step ends.

label.description: Short verb phrase, at most 4 words, like 'sends request'.
